title: Neural Optimal Transport
tldr_zh: weak OT 对偶化为 sup_f inf_T 鞍点，带噪声输入的 T(x,z) 学随机 plan；NN 为 plan 万能逼近器；unpaired 翻译 FID 优于 CycleGAN 系
tldr_en: Weak-OT dual becomes a sup_f inf_T saddle problem; a noise-conditioned network T(x,z) learns stochastic plans; NNs universally approximate plans; strong unpaired I2I FID.
key_numbers: Test FID handbags->shoes 64px: NOT 13.77 (one-to-one) / 13.44 (one-to-many) vs CycleGAN 16.00, DiscoGAN 22.42, MUNIT 15.76, AugCycleGAN 18.84 (Table 1)
Test FID celeba male->female 64px: NOT 13.23 / 11.96 vs CycleGAN 17.74, AugCycleGAN 12.94, MUNIT 17.07 (Table 1)
Test FID outdoor->church 128px: NOT 25.5 / 25.97 vs CycleGAN 46.39, MUNIT 31.42, AugCycleGAN 51.42, DiscoGAN 75.36 (Table 1)
NOT uses 2 networks (T 9.7M + f 22.9M) and 0-1 objective hyperparameters vs CycleGAN 4 nets/2 hp, MUNIT 4 nets/3 hp (Table 2)
gamma-weak cost: gamma=0 conditional collapse, 1/3-2/3 diverse and style-preserving, 1 diverse but style lost (Appendix A, Fig. 7, qualitative)
Training: deterministic maps 1-3 days on 1x V100; stochastic maps on 4x V100 with |Z_x|=4 (Appendix E)
